# DomainProgram catalog

GoliathOmics defines **41** workflow DomainProgram fixture(s) under `workflow_engine/domain/fixtures/*.program.json`. Each program compiles into a GoliathApp workflow graph (`wf.workflow_node` / `wf.workflow_edge`) and is rendered below as a Mermaid flowchart directly from its JSON definition.

## Categories

| Category | Programs | Focus |
|----------|---------:|-------|
| [Sample preparation](sample-prep.md) | 6 | Per-sample upstream preprocessing programs turning raw sequencing reads or mass-spectrometry/panel inputs into QC-gated analysis matrices. |
| [Study validation and SaMD lifecycles](study-lifecycles.md) | 12 | End-to-end study validation, modality lifecycle, and SaMD tier entry-point programs spanning stability, panel freeze, model selection, and hold-out evaluation. |
| [Monte Carlo stability](mc-stability.md) | 6 | Repeated Monte Carlo resampling workflows for centroid seeding, differential detection, optional feature selection, and freeze-readiness evaluation. |
| [Validation freeze and model building](validation-stages.md) | 4 | Post-stability stage programs for panel freezing, production model locking, and model-selection Monte Carlo runs. |
| [Detection, mapping, and interpretation](analysis-and-detection.md) | 10 | Single-pass comparison, differential detection, gene mapping, enrichment, deconvolution, and historical layout programs. |
| [Engine control-flow and event fixtures](engine-and-event-fixtures.md) | 3 | Generic DomainProgram fixtures exercising typed variable assignments, WHILE loops, and event-driven triggers / WAIT_EVENT nodes. |

## Regenerating and reusing diagrams

These pages are generated from the fixture JSON files so diagrams stay in sync with every workflow edit:

```bash
# Regenerate Markdown catalog pages
python3 scripts/generate_domain_program_diagrams.py

# Verify no drift (CI)
python3 scripts/generate_domain_program_diagrams.py --check

# Export standalone .mmd files (for courses or external docs)
python3 scripts/generate_domain_program_diagrams.py --emit-mmd-dir /tmp/domain-program-mmd
```
